ankleSetup: Ikaa amagoro arangerete. Sindeka ebishunwe ase mbere, nyuma bigoke enyuma.
aquaticSetup: Ase amanche matambe, nomogoko, tamboka kana tinda amagoro buya buya.
aquaticSub: Tambora kana raga ebigere ase amache amake.
armLibraryCopy: Guide y'okoinia okoboko na kobuikia oborebu bw'ekibe.
armSetup: Omobere gwa igoro ororwe. Omwana ainie okoboko ase balloons iri.
balanceSetup: Omobere onde orekaneke. Omwana abe boronge omorendi amoere amompi.
ball-throwSetup: Ikara ase therapy ball n'omogoko. Taga na ogwate omopira omororo.
ballThrowSetup: Boka igoro y'omopira gwa therapy n'obwatiano. Rianga na ogwate omopira omorabu.
beadsSetup: Gwata orochigi oronene, ota beads enwe enwe.
bilatSetup: Mokorese amaboko yombi hamwe — kobia, gwata, kana biringania omopira.
breathingSetup: Rara kana ikara buya. Beka okoboko enda, okwe buya buya.
breathingSub: Kwea buya buya, okoboko kori enda.
bridgeSetup: Rara n'omogongo, amarongi agwamerete. Inoria ebebuno bwora-bwora okore ekeraro.
brushSetup: Koresa eburashi enyoro. Burasha amaboko n'amagoro buya nk'omoterapisti agokorokerie.
buttonsSetup: Koresa dressing board erina buttons enene. Menyerera kobweka na koigora.
catchSetup: Rikia ompira omobwasi buya ase obotambe bw'ekuba. Omwana agwatie n'amaboko abere.
clapSetup: Rora kamera. Kuba amaboko imbere y'ekuba buna ekimenyero giaka.
crawlSetup: Tengeneza ase aroro korende. Mogerie agende akoreke ekeg玩cho kiaye akonyete.
crawlSub: Genda amaboko na amarongi goika ase omorero.
cutSetup: Gwata safety scissors n'omogoko. Kenga okorengereria omosuko omonene ogororoku.
dailyPlan: Mpango ya therapy ya kila isiko
dailyPlanCopy: Sira session emwe y'amaboko, emwe y'amagoro, na emwe ya balance, omorendi agwatigane.
drawSetup: Koresa crayon ase karatasi, kana rondokerera ebiero ase amayaga n'ekara.
dressSetup: Koresa practice board eri n'amaboton amanene na zipu.
feedSetup: Tiga esanga ntono ase ekeche. Omwana agitambasie tata koigwa.
gaitLibraryCopy: Amaboko y'okogenda gochigwe na okomenyera amatambokero.
gaitSetup: Kora engira eboronge etari na ebento. Tamba bwora-bwora ase mbere na obokonyi.
gripSetup: Koresa sponge omobwasi kana stress ball. Minya, gwata sekondi 3, buna oreke.
guidedSetup: Tiga omwana aboneke ase kamera, na orenge oborokeri bw'omochiire.
half-kneelSetup: Beka eroti emo ense, na okogoro okonde gosanire emeremo. Ikaransa n'omogoko.
halfKneelSetup: Tiga rite eri rimo ase, na ekigere kinde kiabe emerete ase. Gwara n'obwatiano.
halfKneelSub: Rite eri rimo ase, ekigere kinde emerete.
handwritingSetup: Koresa orogwe kana crayon korengereria emisuko, circles na crosses.
headSetup: Konia omwana aikare. Nyenya ekento kerangerete bwora-bwora arigererie.
headSub: Rigererie enyota eragenda na amariso ao.
heel-raiseSetup: Gwata rail. Imoka chinkoro, ikaransa, nainde ika buya buya.
heelRaiseSetup: Gwara orobao. Inoka ase obosongo bw'ebigere, gwara, bwanyuma oikie buya.
heelRaiseSub: Inoka ase obosongo bw'ebigere, bwanyuma oikie.
horseSetup: Ikara oganchire bolster enene kana peanut ball. Ikaransa korende eting'ane buya buya.
kneelingSetup: Sigama igoro y'omkeka omorabu, amabega ase y'amaru. Gwara ase igo n'obwatiano.
langFallbackNote: UI erabeire n'Ekiero translations chia {lang} chigiete kobwatekanwa.
legLibraryCopy: Amaboko ya PT: imerera okogoro okonogete, gwata rail, nyuma koba na okogoro okonde. Omorendi agwatigane korwa nyuma koraba n'obwanchani.
legSetup: Imerera ase okogoro gokonyara, okonyore omorai. Beta chinyota na okogoro gonde.
marchSetup: Nyora egetumbe gekogokonia. Inoria eriongo riamo goika ase ekebuno korengana n'erongo.
midlineSetup: Tiga ebimenyero orubaju ronde rw'omobere. Omwana atambasie okuboko orenge agati y'omobere.
obstacleSetup: Beka ebinto bike biyorobu ase omosororoko. Rengera kiemo kiemo n'obwatiano.
oralSetup: Koresa straw kana bubble wand. Vuvura buya korentia emisisa y'akanwa.
oralSub: Vuvura bubbles kana nywa na straw.
pinchSetup: Tiga esanga ntono/pom-poms ase tray. Omwana anyore na ekegunwe ekinene n'echara ende.
pinchSub: Nyora esanga ntono ogite ase ekombe.
playdoughSetup: Koresa play dough enyoro. Biriringia, nyinya na oginyinye n'amaboko yare.
pnfSetup: Rigereria okoboko ase na korengera omobere, bwanyuma oigororo na igoro.
proneSetup: Gwaya enda. Egemererie amakoni, oinokie omotwe n'ekifua.
puzzleSetup: Gwata shape, ogita ase ekero ekebwanene nayo.
reachSetup: Tiga egetondo ekeng'ori ase oborebu bw'ekibe. Omwana agerie ase kio.
rollingSetup: Gwaya igoro y'omkeka. Biringana buya korwa omogongo gochia enda, na ogaroke.
rollingSub: Biringana korwa omogongo gochia enda, na ogaroke.
safetyNote: Rekerera korende korore obororo, kizunguzungu, kana obonunu obotari bwa kawaida.
sensorySetup: Tengeneza ebinto 3: ekebwasi, ekegori, na ekire n'amabongo. Omwana akumie kimwe kimwe.
sensorySub: Kumia ebinto ebibwasi, ebigumu, na ebire n'amabongo.
shoulderSetup: Ikaa kana imerera bugima. Garora amabega ase mbere, igoro, enyuma, na ase.
sidelyingSetup: Gwaya orubavu n'obwatiano. Koresa amaboko yombi gokina n'ekeroso.
simonSetup: Omorendi atabe amatambwene. Omwana akore buna Simon atebire yene.
sitstandSetup: Ikaa ase egetumbe gekong'u, amagoro ase. Imerera bwora-bwora, nyuma ika inse.
squatSetup: Amagoro abe oborai bw'amabega, nyora omorai, gwama amarongi gake, nyuma imerera.
step-upSetup: Koresa etagi ense erina rail. Nina n'okogoro goko, nainde okonde.
stepUpSetup: Koresa ekerogo gike ki n'orobao. China n'ekigere kemo, bwanyuma ekinde.
stepUpSub: China igoro na ase y'ekerogo gike.
stretchSetup: Rangania bwora-bwora emechie ekong'u na obokonyi. Gwatia buna kwa sekondi 15–20.
trackSetup: Gwata omotwe totang'ana. Rondokerera ekento egetambaa buya n'amaiso cone.
trunkSetup: Ikaa bugima. Garora omobere igoro ase omosacha na omokungu bwora-bwora.
wall-standSetup: Yemerera omogongo n'ebisinyo bikorire orogoro. Ikaransa n'omogoko.
wallStandSetup: Emera omogongo n'ebisigiro bigwate orokiri. Gwara n'obwatiano.
